name: Creeper Ichor
summary: Across the Hillsbrad forests, moss creepers yield Creeper Ichor to the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill. The Society seeks the fluid as a biological agent for new plagues against the living.

sections.title: Apothecary Research in Hillsbrad
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks natural toxins and catalysts for deadly new brews. He means to eradicate the surrounding human population, and the foothills’ clean air and vibrant life offend him. Among the forest’s giant arachnids, mature moss creepers hold an elusive ichor. It makes an ideal base for his Elixir of Suffering. Mixed with gray bear tongues and other reagents, the fluid helps the Forsaken perfect their lethal alchemy.

faq.answer: Moss creepers throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills yield Creeper Ichor. They include Giant Moss Creepers, Forest Moss Creepers, Elder Moss Creepers, and the notable arachnid Creepthess.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need this fluid?
aliases: what is creeper ichor used for
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon uses Creeper Ichor as a killing agent in his alchemical research. It helps him brew the Elixir of Suffering, meant to plague and exterminate the living humans in Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why is Creeper Ichor so difficult to find?
faq.answer: Moss creepers are common in the forests around Tarren Mill, but usable stores of their virulent ichor are uncommon. Hunters may have to slay many arachnids before finding a usable specimen.

angles.text: As a Forsaken loyalist, securing lethal components like Creeper Ichor advances the Royal Apothecary Society’s campaign to scour the living from Lordaeron.
